kept.title: CSP `unsafe-eval` default fails open when NODE_ENV is not exactly "production"
kept.desc: `allowUnsafeEval` defaults to `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, so any deployment where NODE_ENV is unset or set to something else (e.g. "prod", custom server, edge runtime without inlining) silently ships `script-src ... 'unsafe-eval'`; a fail-closed default (explicit opt-in, e.g. `NODE_ENV === "development"`) plus a test pinning the no-arg/default behaviour would prevent the relaxation from reaching production unnoticed.

kept.title: Truthiness guard still renders a bare "↔" row for partially streamed `between`
kept.desc: `t.between && ...` passes for `[]` or `["A"]` mid-stream, producing an empty or one-sided arrow row; guarding on `t.between?.length === 2` (or on both endpoints) would avoid the half-rendered artifact, and the new test only covers the fully-absent case.
